item.title: Master Leadership Stories with STAR+L ✨ • Start with the Situation: set the scene clearly. • Use: “I led a team of X to achieve Y.” • Explain your Task: your role and goals. • Describe Actions: what you did specifically. • End with Results and Leadership insights.
